name: Shiomi Azumi
source:
Married woman to work as an instructor of a swimming school. Although she tries to be worthy of a serious and rigorous husband, she is secretly accumulating stress during her daily life.

She gave birth to a second child from her husband and no longer has sex with her husband, but doesn't know what to do because of her libido.
